name: Christian V of Denmark
role: King of Denmark and Norway from 1670 to 1699
contribution: King of Denmark and Norway from 1670 until his death in 1699.
legacy: To accommodate non-aristocrats into state service, he created the new noble ranks of count and baron.

checks.lead: Christian V (15 April 1646 – 25 August 1699) was King of Denmark and Norway from 1670 until his death in 1699.
